sources_considered.why: Primary investor disclosure distinguishes completed investment from commitments.
Search results described committed capital. The completed December 2025 investment already establishes that the selected annual shortfall condition was not met.

receipt.public_excerpt: the Company has fully satisfied its commitment to invest in OpenAI

evidence_items.explanation: The paragraph reports a completed $22.5 billion investment on December 26. That payment alone exceeds $20 billion and falls within every completed twelve-month period beginning after publication and ending by the evaluation date; it contradicts the antecedent, not the predicted consequence.
